title: What Do Indonesians Really Need from Language Technology? A Nationwide Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring user awareness of gender stereotypes in language technologies (e.g., AI systems assuming doctors are male and nurses are female) through a nationwide survey.
Measuring user awareness of AI prejudices against specific religious or political groups through a nationwide survey.
Evaluating the disparity in language technology support and available resources across 70+ Indonesian regional languages and dialects to highlight linguistic inequality and underrepresentation.
